children: Venice expects its first data center to come online in November 2026. The planned launch is part of its vertical integration effort to reduce token costs and increase margins by bringing data center operations into the business.

Lower token costs would leave more margin available for discretionary VVV burns, creating a direct connection between data center operations and the resources Venice could allocate to burns. That connection does not establish how much burning would increase. No data center scale, margin magnitude, or burn commitment is stated, so the financial effect and any increase in burns remain contingent.
